scheduling that agents can shape, bring your own AI on AWS Bedrock, storage that uses the server's own AWS role, and the groundwork for the Imara CX edition.

Workforce, availability: agents say when they can work, would like to work and would rather not, per weekday, under Me → Availability. Team leaders see it, and Build schedule follows it.

Workforce, fair schedules: Build schedule can share weekends, late shifts and holidays fairly over the last eight weeks, and start a team's members together where cover allows. Contracts take more rules: most days in a row, fewest days off in a row, fixed days off, and hours counted over 2 to 13 weeks. The schedule review lists any breach.

Workforce, requests: agents can ask to start later, finish earlier or later, or move a break, and the shift changes as soon as it is approved. Trade rules decide which swaps are allowed (same length, other teams, same weekly hours). Rules can approve time off, swaps and shift changes on their own, with notice needed and cover kept, and daily limits set how many people may be off on one day.

Workforce, offers: supervisors post extra hours or the chance to leave early; the first agents to claim them get them.

Workforce, drag and drop: on Schedule → Week, planners move and resize shifts by dragging, copy a day to another date, and publish when ready. Click an agent's name to see their contract, time off balance and waiting requests.

Workforce, adherence: leave a window (an outage, an all-hands) out of adherence for everyone or one team. Two new reports show schedule quality per day and actual against planned time.

Your own AI model on AWS Bedrock: Settings, AI can now use a model in your own AWS Bedrock account, with your access key. Calls and chats stay in the AWS region you pick; cross-region model profiles are refused so data does not leave it. The help guide also explains how to connect Azure OpenAI.

Storage locations: an AWS storage location can use the server's own AWS role instead of an access key, so no key has to be saved.

Agent scripts (first part): a new Scripts page lets you build scripts that guide an agent through a call, step by step, with branches. Five sample scripts get you started. Pick a script for a campaign or a queue. A script can't be used as a number's call flow by mistake. Following a script on the agent desk comes in a later release.

Imara CX edition: the release also carries the Imara CX edition's setup, sign-up, status page, data-privacy and multi-region features. They switch on only for Imara and change nothing for existing organisations."}
